validityOnlyExperiment.note: Full experiment verified against all 352 public cells and 176 research cells; rejected as a general stopping rule after the unfamiliar-gallery counterexample.

sweepNote: Work-only counterfactual using the prior complete panel, one seed. This is not new measurement at every limit and does not measure wall time. The 0.025 choice was subsequently compiled and qualified in full.
limitations: Existing V4 inputs are exposed development demonstrations.
Two zero-jitter seeds produce 176 distinct tracks, not 352 independent trajectories.
0.025 is an explicit compiler stopping tolerance, not a new scorer or a visual-quality guarantee.
Performance on unfamiliar short gallery passages is separately reported and much weaker than the V4 headline.
